data.name: Remain
data.detailed_description:
Remain is a first-person psychological mystery horror game where an amnesiac protagonist explores an abandoned mansion and a derelict hospital, collecting scattered clues and combining keywords to uncover the cruel truth of a forgotten past.

You wake up in an unfamiliar abandoned mansion. No memories. No one around. Explore the eerie and oppressive space, gathering clues one by one. Combine the clues you collect to form new keywords, and as you connect them, you inch closer to the truth you must face. The deduction is intuitive. If a combination is correct, a new keyword unlocks. If not, nothing happens. But as you press forward toward the truth, this place will never let you rest easy.

Key Features First-person psychological mystery horror Clue collection and keyword combination deduction system Immersive horror atmosphere set in an abandoned mansion and derelict hospital Approximately 4 hours of playtime

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains intense violence, including blood effects and blood stains. It also features horror elements such as being pursued by monsters. Players who are sensitive to graphic violence or horror themes should be aware before playing.
